items.title: Jupiter Bear's Club Mansion Sells for $33.8M; Wellington Senior-Living Facility Trades for $30.7M
items.summary: Spec developer Stuart Hankin sold a newly completed 10,900 SF mansion at 228 Bear's Club Drive in Jupiter for $33.8 million to tech executive Derek Kreunen and Erin Kreunen - the week's top recorded South Florida home sale and a sharp markup on the $3.4 million Hankin paid for the lot in 2021 (six bedrooms, theater, pool). The top commercial deal was the Alamar Senior Living facility at 8785 Lake Worth Road in Wellington, which traded for $30.7 million as Chicago-based Walton Street Capital sold to an entity linked to Health Wave Partners. Also closing: a $24 million Boca Raton home at 1992 Royal Palm Way and a $21.6 million ocean-view condo at the Estates at Acqualina in Sunny Isles Beach.

items.title: Key Biscayne Waterfront Home Sells for $17.5M to Lead the Week's Deals
items.summary: A waterfront home at 230 Harbor Drive in Key Biscayne sold for $17.5 million, with Nozin chairman Philippe Touret parting with a property he had owned for decades (6,200+ SF, seven bedrooms; last asked $21.8 million). A Fort Lauderdale home at 8 Harborage Isle Drive followed at $13.7 million - about $1,500 per square foot - and a Palm Beach condo at 2 North Breakers Row, with a cabana unit included, traded for $12.1 million.

items.title: Venetian Islands Double Waterfront Trades for $33M; Miami's 790 Lake Road Fetches $27.3M
items.summary: A trust sold two neighboring 1940s-built waterfront homes at 617 and 625 East Dilido Drive on Miami Beach's Venetian Islands for $33 million (0.7 acres; roughly 5,000 and 4,400 SF) to Leet House 4 LLC - the week's top recorded South Florida home sale. In Miami, a 6,100 SF waterfront home at 790 Lake Road traded for $27.3 million, about $6,700 per square foot (an entity tied to Adonel Concrete CEO Luis Garcia selling; last asked $32 million), and a Wellington equestrian estate at 12940 50th Street with barn space sold for $23 million. On the commercial side, a ~56,300 SF Deerfield Beach warehouse at 1143 West Newport Center Drive sold for $10.6 million.

items.title: Mortgage Rates Rise a Second Straight Week: 30-Yr Fixed 6.55%, 15-Yr 5.93%
items.summary: Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed averaged 6.55% the week of July 16, up from 6.49% and marking a second consecutive weekly increase. The 15-year jumped 11 basis points to 5.93%. A year ago the 30-year FRM was 6.75%, so financing is still cheaper than 2025, and Freddie Mac notes affordability is improving as inventory rises even though purchase-application demand has softened. Bankrate's 30-year jumbo average was 6.63% as of July 15.

items.title: South Florida Commercial Sales Fall 13% to $5.42B in H1 2026 - But Construction Is the Most Intense in the Nation
items.summary: MIAMI REALTORS chief economist Gay Cororaton reports South Florida commercial sales volume fell 13% year over year to $5.42 billion in the first half of 2026 amid geopolitical tensions and macro risk. Volume dropped for multifamily (-12%), office (-32%) and retail (-15%) but rose for industrial (+2%); multifamily still led at $1.95 billion, ahead of industrial ($1.54B), retail ($1.02B) and office ($910M). Broward led counties at $2.35 billion (+7%), ahead of Miami-Dade ($2.05B, -28%) and Palm Beach ($880M, -15%). Pricing held up - median price per building SF rose 1.0% to $330, with retail +24%, office +12% and industrial +7% but multifamily -3%. Fundamentals remain strong: Miami-Dade has 19,131 multifamily units under construction (9.7% of inventory vs 3.5% nationally), and the West Palm Beach-Boca Raton office market has 2.4M SF underway, adding 5.2% to stock - the most intense in the country.

items.title: Sean Combs Sells Star Island Estate for $55M, Leading the Week's Home Deals
items.summary: Sean Combs sold the 8,000 SF, six-bedroom estate at 1 Star Island Drive in Miami Beach for $55 million to JFStar LLC, led by John A. Franklin of Virginia Beach - the week's top recorded South Florida home sale and a $20 million step up from the $35 million he paid in 2021. Also closing: a $8.5M Boca Raton home on West Coconut Palm Road, a $7.9M Jupiter waterfront on Spyglass Lane, and a Sunny Isles Beach condo at $1,500 per square foot.

items.title: Venetian Islands Home Doubles to $42.5M; Royal-Linked Palm Beach Estate Fetches $31.8M
items.summary: A 2025-built waterfront home at 416 West San Marino Drive on Miami Beach's Venetian Islands traded for $42.5 million - nearly double the $23.1 million it fetched in 2024 - with Long Light Capital CEO Justin Korsant selling. In Palm Beach, a trust tied to the late Prince Albrecht of Oettingen-Spielberg sold the oceanfront home at 143 East Inlet Drive for $31.8 million after decades of family ownership, while Coral Gables saw a $24.5M Casuarina Concourse mansion and a $20.5M Balada Street sale by a trust tied to former Tinder CEO Gregory Blatt.

items.title: Longpoint Pays $24.6M for 90K SF Miami Warehouse Complex in Week's Top Commercial Deal
items.summary: A two-building warehouse complex at 8452 Northwest 72nd Street in Miami spanning nearly 90,000 SF sold for $24.6 million - about $273 per square foot - with a trust selling to an affiliate of Boston-based Longpoint. Institutional industrial buyers continue to pay up for infill Miami-Dade logistics product.

items.title: REITs Outperform the Broader Market in H1 2026 on Strong Operating Fundamentals
items.summary: The Nareit All Equity REIT index posted total returns of nearly 15% across the first and second quarters of 2026, beating the Russell 1000 (10.3%) and the S&P 500 (10.2%) despite elevated interest rates - a signal that property-level cash flows, not cheap debt, are driving real estate returns this cycle.

items.title: Palm Island Double-Lot Estate Sells for $40M, Leading the Week's Home Deals
items.summary: Homebuilder Adrian Pedro sold a double-lot estate at 145-149 Palm Avenue on Miami Beach's Palm Island for $40 million to venture investor Ben Ling and Hedge Labs co-founder Christopher Coudron - the week's top recorded South Florida home sale. The property, with a pool, cabana and tennis court, had listed in September asking $59 million; the buyers already own the neighboring mansion.

items.title: Mortgage Rates Tick Back Up: 30-Yr Fixed 6.49%, Jumbo 6.63%
items.summary: Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed averaged 6.49% the week of July 9, up from 6.43% and giving back last week's seven-week low, with the 15-year at 5.82%. Bankrate's 30-year jumbo average rose to 6.63% from 6.60%. A year ago the 30-year FRM was 6.72% - financing remains cheaper than 2025 despite the weekly uptick.

items.title: Sun Sentinel Printing Plant in Deerfield Beach Trades for $65M in Week's Top Commercial Deal
items.summary: The Sun Sentinel's ~382,000 SF printing-press industrial complex at 333 SW 12th Avenue in Deerfield Beach sold for $65 million, with Gramercy Property Trust exiting a site it bought a decade ago for $25.5 million. Also active: Dallas-based Tabani Group's $25.7M purchase of Miami's Wynwood Jungle retail complex and Hertz offloading three parking lots for $13.2 million.

items.title: $193M Miami Freedom Park Permit Tops South Florida Construction Filings
items.summary: The week's largest construction permit was a $193 million filing for Miami Freedom Park near Miami International Airport - a 1M+ SF retail, dining, office and hotel complex with 750 hotel rooms and a 58-acre public park anchored by Inter Miami's completed Nu Stadium. A $180 million permit for Cohen Brothers' West Palm Point office tower at 850 South Quadrille Boulevard in West Palm Beach ranked second.

items.title: Coral Gables Hospital ER Center Trades for $32M, Topping Week's Commercial Deals
items.summary: Coral Gables Hospital's off-campus emergency center at 8665 Bird Road in Miami sold for $32 million - an Amdur Management affiliate selling the nearly 8-acre site to an LLC managed by Supermarket Management. A day earlier, the ~37,000 SF Gun Club Shopping Center at 4645 Gun Club Road in West Palm Beach traded for $15 million.

items.title: Palm Beach $25M Sale Leads the Week; Pinecrest Mansion Fetches $17.5M
items.summary: A 7,200 SF, six-bedroom home at 239 Emerald Lane in Palm Beach sold for $25 million to Terakeet co-founder Mac Cummings, leading South Florida's recorded residential deals for the week. A Pinecrest mansion at 13291 Old Cutler Road followed at $17.5 million.

items.title: Surf Club Four Seasons Condo Asking $32M Tops a Slow Listing Week
items.summary: A condo at the Four Seasons Residences at The Surf Club in Surfside hit the market asking $32 million - the priciest new South Florida listing in an otherwise quiet holiday week, underscoring that trophy oceanfront resale supply is thin but pricing ambitiously.

items.title: Davie School Building Trades for $16M in Week's Top Commercial Deal
items.summary: A ~46,000 SF school building at 3367 North University Drive in Davie sold for $16 million to lead South Florida's recorded commercial deals for the week, while a Pinecrest home at 5865 SW 96th Street topped residential at $7.8 million and a newly built Boca Raton home traded at about $1,200 per square foot.

items.title: Bal Harbour Shops Expansion, Pinnacle Affordable Project Lead Top Permits
items.summary: The week's largest new building permit was an $11.8 million filing for Pinnacle's two-building Pinnacle at Cypress affordable-housing development at 6520 North Andrews Avenue in Fort Lauderdale, while Bal Harbour Shops' luxury retail expansion also ranked among South Florida's top construction permits.

items.title: Mortgage Rates Hit Seven-Week Low: 30-Yr Fixed at 6.43%, Jumbo 6.60%
items.summary: Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed averaged 6.43% the week of July 2, down from 6.49% and well below the 6.67% of a year ago, with the 15-year at 5.79%. Bankrate's 30-year jumbo average eased to 6.60% - a friendlier financing backdrop for SE Florida buyers heading into summer.

items.title: Florida Insurance Rate Cuts Take Effect July 1: Citizens -8.7% Statewide, SE FL Counties ~-14%
items.summary: Florida OIR-approved homeowners rate decreases took effect July 1 for new policies (and at renewal for existing ones). Citizens' average statewide decrease is about 8.7% - with Miami-Dade and Broward seeing cuts near 14% - while private carriers including State Farm (-10.1%) continue filing reductions. More than 15 new insurers have entered since the 2022-23 reforms.

items.title: Palm Beach $21M Sale Leads South Florida's Top Deals into July
items.summary: A ~6,000 SF Palm Beach home at 242 Wells Road traded for $21 million to lead the week's residential deals, joined by a $15.25M Jupiter Inlet beachfront closing, a $13.2M Lighthouse Point waterfront sale and a $10.5M La Gorce Circle sale in Miami Beach - the eight-figure market stayed busy straight into the summer.

items.title: Investor Lists $138M in Trophy Penthouses, Including $78M Miami Beach Unit
items.summary: Investor William Duker put two penthouses on the market for a combined $138 million - including a three-story unit at Miami Beach's Apogee at 800 South Pointe Drive asking $78 million, which would rank among the priciest condo listings in South Florida.

items.title: Florida Property-Insurance Cat Reinsurance Prices Fall 15-20% at June Renewals
items.summary: Guy Carpenter reports risk-adjusted Florida property-catastrophe reinsurance pricing down roughly 15-20% across many layers at the June 2026 renewals, easing a key cost driver for coastal-property carriers and, in turn, homeowner premiums.

items.title: Viceroy Brickell Completes as Villa Miami Climbs - Condo Pipeline Milestones
items.summary: The 45-story Viceroy Brickell - the brand's first fully residential tower - completed construction and is welcoming its first owners, while Villa Miami reached its 37th floor and The Residences at Mandarin Oriental opened its North Tower sales gallery.

items.title: Is South Florida's Branded-Condo Boom Reaching Its Limit?
items.summary: The Real Deal's June magazine examines growing saturation in South Florida's branded-condo market, where dozens of hotel- and designer-branded towers have turned a premium differentiator into the new normal - sharpening the focus on location and developer track record.

items.title: Waterfront Estate of Palm Beach's Oldest Resident Trades for $35M
items.summary: The 6,700 SF waterfront home at 350 Island Road - residence of Palm Beach's oldest resident for over six decades - sold for $35 million in an apparent all-cash deal, months after listing at $41 million. Island trophy product keeps clearing at scale even off peak ask.

items.title: Dezer Pivots to Broader Market With ~600-Unit North Miami Rental Project
items.summary: Dezer Development, long known for ultra-luxury branded condos, is planning nearly 600 market-rate apartments in North Miami - a notable signal that big South Florida developers see the deepest demand in attainable rental product.

items.title: Broward Beach Resort Headed to July 16 Foreclosure Auction Over $40M Debt
items.summary: The Hillsboro Beach Resort at 1159 Hillsboro Mile - a former Sonder property - is set for a July 16 foreclosure auction following a $26 million loan default, a reminder that pockets of hospitality distress persist even in a strong coastal market.

items.title: Colliers: South Florida Multifamily Cap Rates Hold Near 5.0%
items.summary: Colliers' Q1 2026 South Florida multifamily report shows cap rates steady near 5.0% as elevated insurance and operating costs shape pricing. Miami's vacancy is the lowest among major Florida metros at 6.6%, versus Orlando 7.3%, Tampa 8.8% and Jacksonville 12.2%.

items.title: Miami-Dade Home Sales Rise for Ninth Straight Month; SF Median at $680K
items.summary: May 2026 stats from MIAMI Realtors show total Miami-Dade home sales up 7.9% year-over-year - the ninth consecutive monthly gain - with $1M+ sales up 14.7% and the single-family median at $680,000 (+0.7%). Condo inventory fell 8.9%, its fourth straight monthly decline.

items.title: SE Florida Home Sales Up Year-Over-Year for Consecutive Spring Months
items.summary: Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach each posted higher total home sales year-over-year across consecutive spring months, signaling sustained tri-county momentum even as pricing cools from recent highs.

items.title: Palm Beach County Average Sale Price Climbs 11% YTD to $1.025M
items.summary: Palm Beach County's average sale price rose 11% year-to-date from $924,000 to just over $1,025,000, with the median up 3% to $518,500. An unusually high share of cash closings underscores that liquidity, not leverage, is setting the pace.

items.title: South Florida $1M+ Sales Up 22% in Q1 2026
items.summary: Sales of properties priced above $1 million across South Florida rose 22% in Q1 2026 versus a year earlier. In May, Miami-Dade million-dollar sales were up 14.7% year-over-year, extending a strong luxury run.

items.title: West Palm Beach Office Pipeline Tops 3.3M SF as Corporate Relocations Continue
items.summary: West Palm Beach has roughly 3.3 million SF of office space in the pipeline - nearly 700,000 SF under construction - as corporate relocations and financial-services migration cement the city as a regional commercial hub.
items.source: Discover South Florida / Markets of Tomorrow

items.title: Related Breaks Ground / Advances Marquee West Palm Beach Luxury Condos
items.summary: Related Cos. is advancing South Flagler House, and the Nora District marked the groundbreaking of a 201-key boutique hotel - part of a deep West Palm Beach luxury-condo and mixed-use pipeline delivering into 2026-2027.

items.title: Florida Statewide Single-Family Median Hits $425K, Up 2.4% YoY
items.summary: Florida Realtors' May 2026 data put the statewide single-family median at about $425,000, up 2.4% year-over-year, with closed sales rising for the ninth straight month as the market approached a summer inflection point.

items.title: Boca Raton Spec Mansion Asking $80M Poised to Shatter City Record
items.summary: An $80 million spec mansion leading Boca Raton contracts is positioned to set a new city price record, reflecting continued demand for turnkey, ultra-high-end waterfront product in southern Palm Beach County.

items.title: Florida Insurance Trends Shift Toward Relief; Citizens Down to ~395K Policies
items.summary: State-backed Citizens has fallen from 1.42 million policies in late 2023 to roughly 395,000 in January 2026 - the lowest since 2012 - as private carriers file rate decreases and take back risk. SE Florida counties are averaging 11-14% decreases.

items.title: Developer Sells Renovated Palm Beach Waterfront Home for $30.8M
items.summary: Developer Mosie Miller and his wife sold a renovated Palm Beach waterfront home for $30.8 million after more than a year on the market - a sign that even trophy assets are trading on positioning and pricing discipline.
